items.title: Sudarshan Chemical signs deal to buy 15.89% of Sudarshan Colorants India from Dutch unit
items.text: Sudarshan Chemical Industries signed an agreement on 28 September to acquire 3,668,036 shares (15.89%) of Sudarshan Colorants India (formerly Heubach Colorants India) for Rs 150.76 crore, or Rs 410 per share. The seller is its wholly owned subsidiary Sudarshan Europe B.V., so this is an internal restructuring and not a new economic stake bought from an outsider. Completion is due on or after 29 September, and the company plans to hold 70.26% directly, as announced on 12 August 2026. It simplifies the holding structure of the Heubach pigment business in India.
